company.description:
Pensqr : A Twitter but much more organized.

Pensqr (formerly Pngine) will change the way you connect & interact with things that matter you.
They bring you a new content sharing platform to share your thoughts, ideas and opinions about topics that interest you not just with friends but with other like minded people. 
They craft it to value what you share and keep what you love alive, accessible and collectively organized over lifetime.
